Name: SDV-HD2D
Author: ivy0x
Description:
[size=5][b]SDV-HD2D — Public Beta 0.9.0[/b][/size]
Octopath Traveler–style HD-2D for Stardew Valley. The game's own pixel art stands on a lit 3D stage, with dynamic shadows, glowing lamps, bloom, depth of field, cloud shadows and 3D weather.

[b]Rendering only: no gameplay changes and no writes to your save.[/b]
English instructions below; 中文说明见后半部分。
[url=https://github.com/tiwe0/sdv-hd2d-release/releases/tag/v0.9.0]GitHub release and complete installation guide[/url]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley PC 1.6.15.[/*]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] 4.5.2 or later.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28870]StardewUI by focustense[/url] 0.6.1 or later — required for the settings page. Without it, SMAPI will not load this mod.[/*]
[/list]Developed and tested on Windows with SMAPI 4.5.2 and StardewUI 0.6.1. Linux, macOS and community forks such as StardewUI Continued are untested.

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI. For Steam, copy the launch option printed by the installer into Stardew Valley's Steam launch options, including the quotes and %command%. See [url=https://smapi.io/install]SMAPI installation instructions[/url] for other stores.[/*]
[*]Unzip StardewUI into the game's Mods folder: Mods/StardewUI/manifest.json must exist.[/*]
[*]Unzip SDV-HD2D-0.9.0.zip into Mods: Mods/SDV-HD2D/manifest.json must exist. Avoid an extra nested folder.[/*]
[*]Launch through SMAPI. The console should list SDV-HD2D 0.9.0 by ivory and StardewUI 0.6.1.[/*]
[/list][b]Update:[/b] Quit the game and extract the new version over Mods. The archive does not include config.json, so your settings stay.
[b]Uninstall:[/b] Delete Mods/SDV-HD2D. Saves are unaffected.

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]HDR lighting, PBR materials, ambient reflections and water reflections.[/*]
[*]Sun shadows, cloud shadows, contact shadows, and local/dynamic lights with adjustable intensity, range, bounce light and projected shadows.[/*]
[*]Distance fog, ground mist, fireflies, sparks, rain and snow.[/*]
[*]Exposure, bloom, color grading, vignette, depth of field and render scale.[/*]
[*]Orthographic and perspective cameras, adjustable pitch/yaw and perspective field of view (5–30°).[/*]
[*]Entity height correction and fading of objects that hide a character.[/*]
[*]Live settings page in English and Chinese, following the game's language.[/*]
[/list]Settings apply immediately. Save writes only Mods/SDV-HD2D/config.json; Reset restores defaults.

[size=4][b]Controls[/b][/size]
F10 — Open/close settings, also available through the sun tab beside Options.
F8 — Toggle the 3D stage to compare with vanilla.
F9 — Switch orthographic/perspective camera.
F11 — Cell coordinates for bug reports.
F7 — World debug grid.
F6 — CPU/GPU performance overlay.

The default orthographic camera (pitch 40°, yaw 0°) aligns with the original game layout. Mouse targeting follows the 3D picture on flat ground. Perspective or rotated cameras may be one tile off at cliff edges and slopes; switch back to the default orthographic view if needed.

[size=4][b]Performance[/b][/size]
On the development PC at 2560×1440 borderless, VSync on and all effects enabled, measured locations ran at 60 FPS with the default camera and at 12° perspective FOV. At 30° FOV, the farm measured about 54 FPS and the morning Forest about 58 FPS. Results depend on hardware and scene.
If performance drops, lower Render scale, disable Cast shadows or Point projection shadows, disable Depth of field, or reduce perspective FOV.

[size=4][b]Compatibility and known beta limits[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Fishing, combat damage numbers, heart events and festivals are staged in 3D but have not been fully verified in real play.[/*]
[*]Overnight farm events and an event's custom scene retain vanilla 2D drawing. A few special lighting cases use vanilla lighting for that frame.[/*]
[*]Some terrain is inferred imperfectly, including two small waterfalls in the Forest and Mountain.[/*]
[*]Art replacement mods work normally. Map-changing mods receive a generic scene without hand-tuned details.[/*]
[*]Mods that draw custom world graphics may appear flat or misplaced. Other lighting/shader mods may conflict.[/*]
[*]Mods that read the cursor themselves still use the vanilla screen layout.[/*]
[*]Multiplayer and split screen are untested; split-screen mouse targeting retains the game's original layout.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Troubleshooting and reporting[/b][/size]
Missing StardewUI or no F10 settings page? Check Mods/StardewUI/manifest.json and the SMAPI log for StardewUI or SDV-HD2D errors.
For visual bugs, include the location, in-game time, screenshot and F11 cell coordinates.
For performance issues, use F6 or run hd2d_profile dump in the SMAPI console; the report is saved to Mods/SDV-HD2D/.dev/screenshots/frame-profile.json.
Upload SMAPI-latest.txt at [url=https://smapi.io/log]smapi.io/log[/url] and include the generated link in your report.
Other console commands: hd2d_shot [name], hd2d_settings reset, hd2d_settings save, hd2d_stage, hd2d_cells.

[size=4][b]Credits[/b][/size]
StardewUI by focustense provides the settings interface. SMAPI provides the mod loader.

[line]
[size=5][b]中文说明 — 0.9.0 公测版[/b][/size]
SDV-HD2D 把星露谷物语的原有像素美术放到有光照的 3D 舞台上，呈现八方旅人式 HD-2D 效果，包含阴影、发光灯具、泛光、景深、云影与 3D 天气。[b]只改渲染，不改玩法，不写入存档。[/b]

[size=4][b]依赖与安装[/b][/size]
需要 PC 版星露谷物语 1.6.15、SMAPI 4.5.2+、StardewUI 0.6.1+。缺少 StardewUI 时模组不会加载。
[list=1]
[*]安装 SMAPI；Steam 用户按安装器提示设置启动选项。[/*]
[*]把 StardewUI 解压到 Mods，确认 Mods/StardewUI/manifest.json 存在。[/*]
[*]把 SDV-HD2D-0.9.0.zip 解压到 Mods，确认 Mods/SDV-HD2D/manifest.json 存在，不要多套文件夹。[/*]
[*]通过 SMAPI 启动游戏。[/*]
[/list]退出游戏后覆盖解压即可更新，压缩包不含 config.json，会保留设置。卸载只需删除 Mods/SDV-HD2D，不影响存档。
目前在 Windows 上开发和测试；macOS、Linux、StardewUI 社区分支尚未测试。

[size=4][b]设置与按键[/b][/size]
F10 设置；F8 开关 3D；F9 正交/透视切换；F11 格子坐标；F7 世界网格；F6 性能面板。
设置包含阳光与阴影、局部与动态光、氛围、HDR/泛光/景深、镜头与实体五个分区，改动立即生效。保存只写入 Mods/SDV-HD2D/config.json。
默认正交镜头为俯视角 40°、水平旋转 0°，与原版布局对齐。透视或旋转镜头在悬崖边、斜坡上可能出现鼠标偏一格，可切回默认正交镜头。

[size=4][b]公测限制与兼容性[/b][/size]
钓鱼、伤害数字、心事件和节日尚未充分实测；夜间农场事件及事件自带特殊场景保留原版 2D。少数地形（如森林、山区的小瀑布）推导仍不准确。
美术替换模组正常生效；地图模组使用通用场景。自行绘制世界图像的模组可能扁平或错位，自带光照/着色器的模组可能冲突。自行读取鼠标的模组仍按原版布局。多人联机与分屏未测试。
帧率不足时，依次尝试降低渲染比例、关闭太阳/点光投影、关闭景深、减小透视视野角度。

[size=4][b]问题反馈[/b][/size]
请提供地点、游戏内时间、截图和 F11 格子坐标，并附上 [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI 日志链接[/url]。性能问题可按 F6，或在控制台运行 hd2d_profile dump。
